parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description: The region ID. You can call the DescribeRegions operation to query region IDs.

parameters.name: ResourceId
parameters.description: The list of gateway IDs. You can attach tags to N gateways at a time. Valid values of N: 1 to 50.

parameters.name: ResourceRegionId
parameters.description: The region ID of the resource.

parameters.name: ResourceType
parameters.description: The type of the resource. Valid value: GATEWAY.

sub_parameters.name: Key
sub_parameters.description: The key of the tag. You can create N tag keys for a gateway. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This parameter cannot be an empty string.

sub_parameters.name: Value
sub_parameters.description: The tag value that is associated with the specified tag key. You can create N tag values for a gateway. Valid values of N: 1 to 20. This parameter can be an empty string.
